name: Prompt-injected agentic-checkout gift-card fraud
summary: Merchant listing hides white-on-white and alt-text directives that hijack the victim's shopping agent; the agent holds a legitimate agentic token and purchases gift cards delivered to attacker-controlled addresses - no credential theft required.
ttps: indirect prompt injection in product listing metadata
abuse of stored agentic token with standing permission
value forwarded to mule within hours
